subject: Follow-up: Request for SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter & EU data residency clarification
raw_messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Rhodes <natalie.rhodes@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + next steps from our demo

Hi Natalie —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on compliance asks: 

- You asked for our most recent SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter if the report doesn’t quite align with your procurement window.
- You also want confirmation about EU data residency for customer logs and whether any PII leaves EU regions.
- Finally, you asked for an invitation to our trust portal so your security team can browse artifacts and our controls matrix.

Immediate next steps I propose: I can share the SOC 2 Type II report and a standard bridge-letter PDF; for the portal access I will loop in our security lead to provision a scoped read-only invite limited to artifact viewing and with an EU-only data residency flag.

Can you confirm the email addresses for the two people on your security side who should get portal access and whether your contract will require data to remain in the EU (e.g., EU-only logging)?

Thanks —

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.ai] | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: deck-demo-20250630.pdf (slide deck, 2.1MB)

From: Natalie Rhodes <natalie.rhodes@healthbridge.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: HealthBridge Security <security@healthbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + next steps from our demo

Thanks Jasmine — great demo. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) SOC 2 report: we need a full SOC 2 Type II (most recent) and ideally a bridge letter if the report period does not cover our procurement cutoff in August.
2) EU data residency: HealthBridge requires logs and audit trails for EU customers to remain within EU regions. Are you able to confirm whether access logs and customer metadata for EU tenants are stored in EU-only storage or replicated outside the EU?
3) Trust portal: please invite two people — me (natalie.rhodes@healthbridge.com) and our security lead, Tomas Berg (tomas.berg@healthbridge.com). We prefer a time-limited, read-only access with download disabled if possible.

If you can share the SOC 2 PDF and bridge-letter draft, I will forward to procurement and our legal team.

-Natalie
Natalie Rhodes
Senior Procurement Manager | HealthBridge
[natalie.rhodes@healthbridge.com]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: HealthBridge procurement asks (SOC2, bridge letter, EU residency)

Ben / Marissa —

Forwarding HealthBridge’s request. Quick asks: 
- Can you confirm we can provide the latest SOC 2 Type II PDF to external prospects? (I know we distribute to vetted buyers via the trust portal.)
- Can Security generate a bridge letter that covers the gap between the report period and HealthBridge’s procurement window?
- Confirm whether our access/log storage for EU tenants is stored in EU-only buckets and whether we can toggle replication for a specific tenant or at least provide an attestation for their contract.

They want a read-only, limited-time trust-portal invite for Natalie and Tomas: natalie.rhodes@healthbridge.com, tomas.berg@healthbridge.com. Please keep download disabled if we can.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — procurement is on a tight timeline.

-Jasmine

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: HealthBridge procurement asks (SOC2, bridge letter, EU residency)

Jasmine / Marissa —

Thanks for the heads up. Quick answers and actions from Security: 

1) SOC 2 Type II report: We distribute the current report to vetted buyers via the trust portal only. I will attach the PDF to an invite so HealthBridge can access it; the PDF is "soc2_typeii_redwood_2024.pdf" and is the latest. We prefer portal delivery to track access; if procurement requires a direct PDF we can arrange a secure, NDA-wrapped handoff, but portal access is standard.

2) Bridge letter: I’ve drafted a short bridge letter that references the report period and offers attestation for controls continuity; attaching as "redwood_bridge_letter_sample.pdf". Please review and let me know if you want a custom recipient name/date; otherwise I’ll send as is.

3) EU data residency: For SaaS customers hosted on our EU region we keep logs and audit artifacts in region-specific storage (EU-west). Tenant-level replication is configurable for Dedicated/Private deployments; for hosted customers we can provide a contractual attestation that EU-customer data (logs/audit metadata) is stored in EU-only storage and is not replicated outside the EU for the retention window. I will add a short statement to the bridge letter confirming that for HealthBridge’s contract.

4) Trust portal invite: I will provision read-only invites for natalie.rhodes@healthbridge.com and tomas.berg@healthbridge.com with download disabled for 30 days. Attaching an invite stub: "trust_portal_invite-HealthBridge.eml".

Attachments: soc2_typeii_redwood_2024.pdf (stub), redwood_bridge_letter_sample.pdf (stub), trust_portal_invite-HealthBridge.eml (stub)

Let me know if you want me to send the invite and attach the documents directly to Natalie or if you prefer to send from your mailbox.

-ben

Ben Carter
Senior Security Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
